topics.name: Development with AWS Services
topics.description: Developing code for applications hosted on AWS, developing code for AWS Lambda, and using data stores in application development.

subtopics.name: Develop Code for Applications Hosted on AWS
subtopics.description: Architectural patterns, APIs, messaging, SDKs, and resilient code.
keyPoints: Architectural patterns: event-driven, microservices, monolithic, choreography, orchestration, fanout
Stateful vs stateless and tightly vs loosely coupled components; synchronous vs asynchronous
Create and maintain APIs (request/response transformations, validation, status codes)
Write code that calls AWS services using APIs and AWS SDKs; handle streaming data
Use Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, and Amazon EventBridge for messaging and event-driven patterns
Implement resilient integrations: retry logic, circuit breakers, error handling

subtopics.name: Develop Code for AWS Lambda
subtopics.description: Configuring, integrating, and tuning Lambda functions.
keyPoints: Configure functions: memory, concurrency, timeout, runtime, handler, layers, extensions, triggers, destinations
Access private VPC resources from Lambda code
Handle event lifecycle and errors with Lambda Destinations and dead-letter queues
Integrate Lambda with other AWS services and tune for performance
Use Lambda for near-real-time data processing and transformation
subtopics.content:
**AWS Lambda** runs code without managing servers.

- Handle failures with a **dead-letter queue (DLQ)** or **destinations**.
- Reduce **cold starts** with **provisioned concurrency**.
- Share dependencies across functions with **layers**.
- Tune memory (which also scales CPU) to balance cost and latency.

subtopics.name: Use Data Stores in Application Development
subtopics.description: DynamoDB, caching, consistency, and access patterns.
keyPoints: Use high-cardinality partition keys for balanced DynamoDB partition access
Consistency models: strongly consistent vs eventually consistent
DynamoDB keys, indexing, and query vs scan operations
Serialize/deserialize data and manage data lifecycles (for example, TTL)
Use caching services (Amazon ElastiCache, DAX) and access-pattern-specific stores (Amazon OpenSearch Service)

topics.name: Security
topics.description: Implementing authentication and authorization, implementing encryption, and managing sensitive data in application code.

subtopics.name: Authentication and Authorization
subtopics.description: Identity, tokens, IAM, and programmatic access.
keyPoints: Use identity providers for federated access (Amazon Cognito, IAM)
Secure applications with bearer tokens; make authenticated calls to AWS
Assume IAM roles and use AWS STS for temporary credentials
Define permissions for IAM principals and least-privilege policies
Implement application-level, fine-grained authorization; handle cross-service auth in microservices

subtopics.name: Encryption with AWS Services
subtopics.description: Encryption at rest/in transit and key management.
keyPoints: Encryption at rest and in transit; client-side vs server-side encryption
Use AWS KMS keys to encrypt/decrypt data and manage key rotation
Certificate management (AWS Private CA); generate certificates and SSH keys
Use encryption across account boundaries
subtopics.content:
Protect data with **AWS KMS**:

- Encrypt **at rest** (server-side) and **in transit** (TLS).
- Use **customer managed keys** for control over rotation and policies.
- **Envelope encryption** wraps data keys with a KMS key; enable automatic **key rotation** where possible.

subtopics.name: Manage Sensitive Data in Application Code
keyPoints: Data classification (PII, PHI); sanitize and mask sensitive data at the application level
Encrypt environment variables that contain sensitive data
Use AWS Secrets Manager and Systems Manager Parameter Store to secure secrets
Implement data access patterns for multi-tenant applications

topics.name: Deployment
topics.description: Preparing application artifacts, testing in development environments, automating deployment testing, and deploying with AWS CI/CD services.

subtopics.name: Prepare and Test Application Artifacts
keyPoints: Manage code module dependencies (env vars, config files, container images) within packages
Prepare environment-specific configurations (AWS AppConfig)
Test deployed code with AWS services/tools; write integration tests and mock external APIs
Test with development endpoints (API Gateway stages) and test event-driven applications

subtopics.name: Automate Deployment Testing and IaC
subtopics.description: Test events, environments, and infrastructure as code.
keyPoints: Create application test events (JSON payloads for Lambda, API Gateway, SAM)
Use approved versions for integration testing (Lambda aliases, container image tags)
Implement and deploy IaC templates (AWS SAM, AWS CloudFormation)
Manage development, test, and production environments in individual services

subtopics.name: CI/CD Deployment
subtopics.description: Deploying with AWS CI/CD services and strategies.
keyPoints: Lambda deployment packaging options; API Gateway stages and custom domains
Commit code to invoke build, test, and deploy actions (CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline)
Deployment strategies: blue/green, canary, rolling; perform rollbacks
Use labels/branches for version and release management; orchestrate multi-environment deploys

topics.name: Troubleshooting and Optimization
topics.description: Assisting in root cause analysis, instrumenting code for observability, and optimizing applications.

subtopics.name: Root Cause Analysis
subtopics.description: Debugging with metrics, logs, and traces.
keyPoints: Debug code to identify defects; interpret application metrics, logs, and traces
Query logs (CloudWatch Logs Insights) to find relevant data
Implement custom metrics (CloudWatch embedded metric format)
Troubleshoot deployment failures and service integration issues using service output logs

subtopics.name: Instrument Code for Observability
keyPoints: Differences between logging, monitoring, and observability
Implement effective and structured logging for application events and user actions
Emit custom metrics and add annotations for tracing (AWS X-Ray)
Configure notification alerts, health checks, and readiness probes

subtopics.name: Optimize Applications
keyPoints: Define concurrency; profile application performance and determine minimum memory/compute
Cache content based on request headers (CloudFront) and implement application-level caching
Use subscription filter policies to optimize messaging
Optimize resource usage and use application logs to find performance bottlenecks
